comments.content: The metric update is only reached on the `can_read` and `!can_read` branches, but the early `if (need_stop) return;` path skips it. More importantly, when the disk transitions to broken, the readonly flag may also change (e.g. `disk->readonly` is not reset when broken), so the readonly metric delta computed here may be stale. Consider updating metrics before the early return and ensuring both flags are captured consistently. Also, `diskStatusChange` is defined in the global namespace in a .cpp file — it should be `static` or in an anonymous namespace to avoid ODR/linkage issues.

`diskStatusChange` is a non-static free function with external linkage in a translation unit. This can cause ODR violations if another TU defines the same symbol. Mark it `static` or wrap it in an anonymous namespace.

`formatReadableTime` expects seconds, but the argument is `check_period_ms * 1e6` which converts ms to ns, not seconds. This will print a wildly incorrect value. It should be `check_period_ms / 1000.0` (or `* 1e-3`).

The log message no longer includes the disk name, but the logger is now `DiskLocal(<name>)` (see DiskLocal.cpp change), so this is fine. However, the `SYSTEM RESTART DISK {0}` placeholder still uses `disk->getName()` — verify the argument is still passed. It is, so OK.
